task_description: Investigate and resolve why instructors cannot approve proposals on the instructor side in Capstone 1, tracing client-side and backend guards.
root_causes: 1-based vs 0-based array index mismatch: Capstone1CollapsibleSections passed proposalId: activeProposal.index where index = idx + 1 (1-based), while server project.service.js:approveTitle validated proposalIndex strictly as 0-based (< 0 || >= proposals.length). For single-proposal teams, 1 >= 1 threw 404 TITLE_PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND. For multi-proposal teams, selecting proposal 1 approved proposal 2.
addTitleComment also received the 1-based index from activeProposal.index, throwing 404 whenever deliberation remarks were entered.
Strict titleStatus === 'submitted' gate threw 400 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION if proposal was in draft or revision_required, blocking instructor deliberation.
Defense hearing requirement lacked inline scheduling integration: clicking approve without a scheduled defense hearing displayed a dead-end error toast without inline action.

modifications.summary: Added multi-strategy proposal identification (MongoDB _id on metadata/proposals, title string, 0-based index, and 1-based index fallback) in approveTitle and addTitleComment. Auto-advances DRAFT and REVISION_REQUIRED to SUBMITTED to unblock deliberation.
Added unit tests verifying 1-based index resolution, metadata _id resolution, and DRAFT status auto-advancement.

Passed canonical selectedProposalIndex (0-based) to approveTitleMutation.mutateAsync and activeProposal.id / selectedProposalIndex to addCommentMutation.mutateAsync. Integrated ScheduleDefenseModal directly into the Deliberation Studio with amber/emerald defense status indicator.
Added mocks and unit tests for scheduled approval, schedule modal button, and auto-opening modal on unscheduled approval attempt.
